summary: Frontend testing complete for Scope 2 emission calculation fixes. All 4 features verified successfully: (1) Quantity unit auto-selects kWh when electricity fuel selected, (2) Unit conversion displays on first attempt without requiring multiple tries, (3) 1000 kWh correctly calculates to 0.71 tCO2 (not 710 tCO2), (4) Calculation details show the conversion: 1000 kWh × 0.001 = 1 MWh.

feature_1_quantity_unit_auto_selection.description: When selecting electricity fuel, the quantity unit auto-selects to kWh (not default kg)
feature_1_quantity_unit_auto_selection.test_scenario: Selected Scope 2 → test-1 (India) facility → Purchased Electricity category → Electricity (India) fuel
feature_1_quantity_unit_auto_selection.evidence: Screenshot shows Kilowatt-hour (kWh) selected in quantity unit dropdown

feature_2_unit_conversion_first_attempt.description: Unit conversion displays on FIRST attempt without needing multiple tries
feature_2_unit_conversion_first_attempt.test_scenario: After selecting Electricity fuel and entering 1000 quantity
feature_2_unit_conversion_first_attempt.actual: Unit Conversion Applied (from Super Admin Parameters): 1000 kWh × 0.001 = 1 MWh displayed on first load
feature_2_unit_conversion_first_attempt.evidence: Dialog content shows conversion immediately after fuel selection

feature_3_scope2_calculation_correct.description: 1000 kWh input correctly converts to 1 MWh and calculates 0.71 tCO2 (NOT 710 tCO2)
feature_3_scope2_calculation_correct.test_scenario: Electricity (India) fuel with emission_factor_basis=0.71, quantity=1000 kWh
feature_3_scope2_calculation_correct.actual: CO₂ Emissions: 0.71 tCO2, CO₂e Total: 0.71 tCO2
feature_3_scope2_calculation_correct.formula_applied: Electricity Emissions: quantity of electricity × Emission factor of electricity

feature_4_calculation_details_show_conve.description: Calculation details show the unit conversion step
feature_4_calculation_details_show_conve.actual: Calculation Details shows: '1000 kWh × 0.001 = 1 MWh' and 'quantity of electricity = 1'
feature_4_calculation_details_show_conve.evidence: Dialog shows full calculation breakdown with conversion step

critical_code_review_comments: FIX VERIFIED: handleFuelSelect (lines 197-240) now correctly auto-sets quantity_unit based on fuel's allowed_units - for electricity, it finds energy units (kWh, MWh, GWh) and sets the first one as default
FIX VERIFIED: formulaDataReady state (line 29) added to track when formula parameters are loaded
FIX VERIFIED: calculatedEmissions useMemo (line 655-659) now waits for formulaDataReady before calculating, preventing race condition where calculations ran before unit conversions were loaded
FIX VERIFIED: getConversionFactor (lines 418-458) correctly handles electricity_quantity parameter with conversion: 1000 kWh → 1 MWh (divides by multiplier 1000)
seed_data_used: Facility test-1 (India) with Electricity (India) fuel (emission_factor_basis=0.71 tco2/mW)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scope 2 emission calculation bug is FIXED. The key fixes were: (1) handleFuelSelect now auto-sets quantity_unit to kWh for electricity fuels, (2) formulaDataReady state ensures calculations wait for formula parameters to load, (3) calculatedEmissions correctly uses the converted quantity value (1000 kWh → 1 MWh) in the formula. Result: 1000 kWh × 0.001 × 0.71 = 0.71 tCO2.
